parked.spanish: Y tocarán con ellas, y se reunirá a ti toda la congregación a abertura de tienda de reunión.

findings.issue: Niphal sequential perfect is 3rd common plural; se reunirá is singular, smoothed to agree with singular כָּל הָעֵדָה. Same participants and niphal middle sense.

parked.spanish: Y dijo Moisés a Hobab hijo de Reuel el midyaní, suegro de Moisés: Partientes somos nosotros al lugar que dijo Jehová: A él daré a ustedes; anda con nosotros, y haremos bien a ti, porque Jehová ha hablado bien sobre Israel.

findings.issue: somos is an unmarked supplied copula; the clause is a verbless participle plus pronoun
Gentilic common noun is left as the Hebraized form midyaní instead of Spanish
A él treats the direct object (the place) as a personal male recipient, so the thing given is no longer the place
2fs suffix is smoothed to gender-neutral a ti; person and number stay 2sg

parked.spanish: Y en su descansar dice: Vuelve, Jehová, miríadas de miles de Israel.

findings.issue: Qal imperfect 3ms is rendered as present “dice”. Person, number, and stem match; imperfect tense stays open, so the present is grammatical smoothing.

The imperative is tagged with an unspecified suffix (שׁוּבָה). “Vuelve” keeps qal imperative 2ms and does not express that suffix. The packet does not identify a pronominal person, so no participant is changed.
